mapper.sql: select source_id, source_type, list_id, list_url, name, region_tag, object_type, max_page, target_collection_id, enabled, last_run_at, last_status, create_by, create_time, update_time, remark from km_mdl_source
mapper.select: where enabled = '0' and (source_type = 'mdl' or source_type is null) order by source_id asc
where enabled = '0' and source_type = #{sourceType} order by source_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into km_mdl_source (source_type, list_id, list_url, name, region_tag, object_type, max_page, target_collection_id, enabled, create_by, create_time, remark) values (ifnull(#{sourceType},'mdl'), #{listId}, #{listUrl}, #{name}, #{regionTag}, #{objectType}, ifnull(#{maxPage},1), #{targetCollectionId}, ifnull(#{enabled},'0'), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from km_mdl_source where source_id in #{id}
